title: Where novels are set: a map of fiction's real places
excerpt: I mapped the real settings of 7,300 novels in Wikidata. London, New York and Paris dominate, most authors stay within a few hundred kilometres of where they were born, and Denmark has more mapped places than China and India together.
seo_description: A map of where 7,300 novels are set: London, Paris and New York over two centuries, how far authors travel, and the unwritten world.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where novels are set' in black, red and blue on pale paper, beside a world map with red circles for the settings of novels, the largest on London, Paris and New York, a dense cluster over Europe and only scattered small circles across Asia, Africa and South America. Text: 7,300 novels set in 2,209 real places, from Wikidata.
